jobs.title: DevOps Team Lead
jobs.description: Who are we? Planck, now a part of Applied Systems Inc., is revolutionizing the insurance market with its advanced use of Generative AI (GenAI). Our state-of-the-art platform turns unstructured data into real-time, actionable insights, enabling insurance companies to make smarter, faster decisions. As the AI hub for Applied Systems, we are uniquely positioned at the forefront of the industry, driving significant advancements and delivering exceptional value to our clients. Joining Planck means working in a dynamic startup environment while benefiting from the resources and maturity of a market leader like Applied Systems. We foster an inclusive culture that supports professional development and work-life balance. At Planck, you'll be at the cutting edge of technology, shaping the future of insurance while advancing your career within the larger framework of Applied Systems. What are we looking for? We are looking for a DevOps Team Lead to join our AI revolution! You'll lead a small, senior team and own the foundation our engineering teams build on. Your team's work will directly impact how fast and confidently we ship — from architecting resilient cloud infrastructure to getting our next generation of GenAI agents running in production. You'll stay hands-on while you lead, set the technical direction for DevOps at Planck, and partner closely with our Platform team and with R&D leadership across Applied Systems. There's plenty still to figure out — most of all, how this team plugs into Applied's wider DevOps and Cloud Engineering organization. You'll have a real say in shaping that. What will you do? • Lead and grow a team of DevOps engineers — 1:1s, performance, and career development • Set the team’s priorities and technical direction, and align them with R&D leadership • Shape how the team fits into Applied’s DevOps and Cloud Engineering organization - how work comes in, how priorities get set, and how decisions get made • Stay hands-on: architect and build cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling alongside your team DevOps Team Lead - Job Description August 2026 Build what it takes to run our GenAI and agent-based services in production - scalable, observable, and efficient to operate • Own production reliability for the team’s services: SLOs, observability, incident response, and on-call • Drive cloud cost efficiency and strengthen our security posture, together with the Platform and Security teams What should you have? • 6+ years of hands-on DevOps experience • 3+ years managing a DevOps team - direct reports, performance, and growth • Experience managing a team within a global organization, reporting to a remote US-based manager • Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production environments • Strong experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) • Proven experience building and maintaining complex CI/CD pipelines • Solid hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and GitOps (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) • Experience owning production reliability end-to-end - observability, incident response, and on- call • Fluent English, and comfortable with US working norms and overlap hours﻿ ● Stock options for all employees ● Team activities, fully-stocked kitchen, yoga class, functional training class and more ● High amount of PTO days and work-life balance
